transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
I guess… I’ve just been getting stuck on this feeling that I’m not really cut out for my role. Like I somehow convinced people I could handle more than I actually can. It’s been hard to shake.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot about your performance or abilities, even when there’s no immediate reason to?

Yeah… I do. Mostly about work. I keep thinking I’m not really senior material, like I somehow fooled people into thinking I can handle more than I actually can. It’s hard not to beat myself up over it.
Do you find yourself having thoughts that keep coming back, even when you try to push them away, or feel the need to do certain things over and over to ease your mind?
I don’t think so… not in that way. I mean, I get stuck thinking about work stuff, but I don’t really have rituals or anything I have to do over and over to feel okay.
Do you find that your worries aren’t limited to just work—like maybe relationships, health, or other responsibilities—or do they tend to stay focused on your job and abilities at work?
Mostly work, I think. It’s that same thing… feeling like I’m not really senior material, like I fooled people into thinking I can handle more than I can. I just keep beating myself up over that.
Do you feel anxious or worried about things in your life outside of work, like personal relationships, health, or other responsibilities, even when there’s no clear reason to be?
Not really, no. I mean… normal stuff comes up, but I haven’t noticed myself worrying like that outside of work.
Do you find it hard to control your worrying about work, even when you try to focus on something else or tell yourself it’s not that bad?

Yeah… I guess it is hard to shut off. I tell myself it’s probably not that bad, but I keep coming back to the same thing—that I’m not really senior material, and I somehow made people think I could handle more than I actually can.
Have you noticed any physical symptoms like restlessness, trouble sleeping, or difficulty concentrating when you're worrying about work?
Yeah… mostly sleep. I’ll wake up too early thinking about client tickets and then I can’t really get back to sleep. Or I get enough hours, technically, but still feel pretty worn out.
How long have you been feeling this way about your work and abilities?
Maybe about a month. It got more noticeable after they asked me to cover the senior analyst stuff… that’s when I started feeling more up and down about it.
Have you noticed feeling down or losing interest in things you usually enjoy, even outside of work?
Yeah… I mean, I wouldn’t say I’m totally checked out, but most days lately I’ve had this kind of heavy, low feeling. Like I’m just getting through work and home with everything sort of… dimmed down.
Do you find that this low feeling sticks around most of the day, even on days when nothing particularly stressful happens at work?
Yeah… I think so. Even when work isn’t especially bad, it’s still kind of there most of the day. Just this heavy, low feeling, like everything’s sort of muted.
Do you find yourself feeling guilty or like you’re a failure because you worry you can’t handle the responsibilities people expect from you at work?

Yeah… that’s a big part of it, I guess. I keep thinking I’m not really senior material, like I somehow fooled them into thinking I could handle more than I actually can. It’s hard not to beat myself up over that.
Do you feel this guilt or sense of being a failure even in situations outside of work, like with friends or family, or does it mostly stay connected to your job?

Mostly the job, I think. It’s… that’s what I came in about. I keep beating myself up, like I’m not really senior material and I somehow fooled everyone into thinking I could handle more than I can. With family or friends, I don’t know… not as much.
Do you find that this heavy, low feeling and guilt about work affects most of your day, nearly every day, even when you're not actively thinking about work?

Yeah… most days lately, it’s there. Even when I’m not directly thinking about work, I feel kind of weighed down, like I’m just getting through things at work and at home with everything sort of… dulled.
Have you noticed a loss of energy or feeling fatigued most days, even when you haven’t been doing much physically or mentally taxing?
Yeah… I guess so. By the time I get home from the office, even little things like checking the mail or loading the dishwasher feel like… more effort than they should.
